next_question.rationale: Play Store reports and the cluster "customer went back from payments page" point to a payments or app problem that could be geographically local (payment providers, app rollout, or telco stability). I expect a small number of high-volume regions to show much lower conversion from "started a booking" to "chose a slot and confirmed" than the rest; if true, that will localise the UX/payment fix to specific markets and explain a large share of the 4,804 lost bookings.
